notes.fixed: The enforced eager cap includes entry JS, modulepreload/static-import JS and eager CSS. The existing PWA cap includes its two metadata entries and reserved metadata bytes.
notes.provisional: CSS and largest-lazy caps were frozen at ceil(270f observed value * 1.05), before Round 3 treatment results. They are provisional, not performance claims.
notes.compression: gzip level 9, independently per file, summed after deduplication. Fonts, JSON and the root worker are not part of the eager JS+CSS gate.
notes.lazy: All emitted assets/*.js outside the eager set; raw and gzip maxima are measured separately. The root service worker is excluded.
